part2.question: Describe a friend's home you visited and liked but didn't want to live there

segments.v: I want to talk about my best friend Linh's house. It is in the Old Quarter of Hà Nội. I often go there. It is a tall and narrow house with five floors. It is very old, about one hundred years old. There are old tiles, old photos and a wooden altar. There is a rooftop with many plants. I like visiting it because it is beautiful and it has a lot of history. Linh's grandmother tells me stories about the old times. The house is also in the city centre, so there is a lot of street food. But I don't want to live there. There are too many stairs and the rooms are small and dark. It is very noisy at night and there is no place to park. It is also wet in the rainy season.
